faq.q: What is the recommended title length?
faq.a: 50–60 characters is the classic guideline. Google truncates longer titles in search results, so keeping the key phrase early and within range preserves it.

faq.q: Is pixel width a better measure than characters?
faq.a: Yes — Google truncates by pixel width, not character count. This tool estimates both, with characters as the quick guideline and pixel width as the finer check.

faq.q: Should my brand name be in the title?
faq.a: Putting your brand after the page phrase is common — for example 'Page Title | Brand Name'. Keep the total under the limit and put keywords first.
Yes. Titles are one of the strongest on-page signals and directly affect click-through rate. They are often the first thing a searcher sees.
